---
title: "Machine Learning"
---

A practical, project-oriented course on machine learning. Students learn the full workflow, from data preparation and feature engineering to model selection, training, evaluation, and deployment, using Python.

## Topics

1. **Python for Data Science**: NumPy, pandas, and visualization.
2. **Data Preparation**: cleaning, imputation, encoding, and scaling.
3. **Supervised Learning**: regression and classification (linear models, trees, ensembles, KNN).
4. **Unsupervised Learning**: clustering (K-means, hierarchical) and dimensionality reduction.
5. **Model Evaluation**: cross-validation, metrics, and hyperparameter tuning.
6. **Deep Learning Introduction**: neural networks and training basics.
7. **Project**: end-to-end machine-learning project on a real dataset.

## Learning Outcomes

By the end of the course, students will be able to:

- Build complete machine-learning pipelines in Python.
- Select and tune appropriate algorithms for a task.
- Evaluate models rigorously and communicate results.
- Recognize the practical considerations of deploying models in industry.
